The project is complete. Here's a summary of what was implemented:

**Project structure** (`output/`):
- `Cargo.toml` — No external dependencies, Rust 2021 edition
- `src/main.rs` — CLI parsing, `parse` and `expand` subcommands
- `src/types.rs` — Date/time types, arithmetic, parsing, formatting
- `src/parser.rs` — Content line unfolding, parameter parsing (RFC 6868 `^` escaping), component tree building
- `src/model.rs` — All typed structures matching the output schema
- `src/builder.rs` — Component-to-model conversion, iTIP validation, RRULE/RDATE/EXDATE parsing
- `src/rrule.rs` — Full RRULE expansion (all BYxxx parts, BYSETPOS, COUNT/UNTIL, invalid-date dropping, WKST)
- `src/timezone.rs` — VTIMEZONE resolution (observance RRULE expansion, transition lookup, TZOFFSETFROM/TO, pre-first-observance fallback)
- `src/expand.rs` — Occurrence generation with timezone conversion, RDATE/EXDATE handling, RECURRENCE-ID overrides (point and THISANDFUTURE), EXRULE
- `src/json_out.rs` — Custom JSON serializer (no serde needed)

**Key capabilities verified**:
- Full VEVENT/VTODO/VJOURNAL/VFREEBUSY/VTIMEZONE/VAVAILABILITY/VALARM parsing
- Complete ATTENDEE grammar (CN, CUTYPE, ROLE, PARTSTAT, RSVP, MEMBER, DELEGATED-FROM/TO, SENT-BY, DIR)
- RFC 7986 calendar properties (NAME, COLOR, IMAGE, CONFERENCE, REFRESH-INTERVAL, SOURCE)
- RFC 9074 VALARM extensions (UID, ACKNOWLEDGED, PROXIMITY, RELATED-TO)
- RFC 7953 VAVAILABILITY with AVAILABLE sub-components
- RRULE expansion with BYSETPOS, ordinal BYDAY, invalid-date dropping, DST-crossing timezone resolution
- VTIMEZONE resolution with STANDARD/DAYLIGHT observances and their RRULEs
- RECURRENCE-ID point overrides and cancelled events
- iTIP validation (per-METHOD, per-component required property checks)
- Proper ISO-8601 normalization (DATE, floating, UTC, colonized UTC offsets)
- Error output on exit code 1 with line/column info
